statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Contact header field MUST be present and contain exactly one SIP or SIPS URI in any request that can result in the establishment of a dialog.
actions: Include Contact header field in outgoing dialog-establishing request
Ensure Contact header field contains exactly one SIP or SIPS URI

statements.subject: message
statements.description: That is, the Contact header field value contains the URI at which the UA would like to receive requests, and this URI MUST be valid even if used in subsequent requests outside of any dialogs.
actions: Populate Contact header URI with a globally valid address reachable outside any dialog context

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the Request-URI or top Route header field value contains a SIPS URI, the Contact header field MUST contain a SIPS URI as well.
actions: Set Contact header URI scheme to SIPS when Request-URI or top Route header contains a SIPS URI
